scenes.line: It's eleven p.m. A kid is playing online. And someone is being very, very nice.
Last year, one US hotline got more than fifty thousand sextortion reports. About one hundred thirty seven a day.
Parents can't read every chat. And kids don't always see the trick.
Meet Night Guard. An open model that reads the chat on the family's own computer.
When a stranger asks for a secret, it warns the kid right away, in words they get.
Parents get one alert. Not the whole chat. Just what happened, and what to do now.
Gemma runs it locally and even reads the screen. Tinker taught a model our format. Temporal survives crashes. Sentry traces every check, with no chat inside.
The more the kid learns, the lazier the guard gets. That's the lazy payoff.
